summary.intent: Resolve all outstanding automated PR review comments (Copilot and CodeRabbit) on PR #392, then investigate and fix a CI release gate gap where `test:` commits could merge to main without E2E verification blocking the release-please PR.
summary.outcome: All 3 review comments were fixed, committed, and resolved. A separate fix (PR #394) was created to retrigger the release gate on open release-please PRs after E2E completes on main, closing the merge-without-verification gap. A mistaken PR #393 was also opened and closed.

repo: The release gate (`release-gate.yml`) auto-passes for non-release PRs with 'Not a release PR — E2E gate not applicable', meaning `test:` commits can merge to main and stale green checks on the release-please PR are never invalidated.
E2E workflow (`e2e.yml`) only triggers on `push` to `main`, not on PRs — this is intentional since E2E runs against staging.
CodeRabbit has a per-hour quota and can be rate-limited; when re-requesting reviews expect ~20-30 minute delays.
Committed test fixtures live in `tests/web-e2e/fixtures/files/` and are guarded by a `COMMITTED_FIXTURES` set — overwriting them during cleanup would delete tracked files.

Phase 34 (`34-e2e-test-expansion-staging-baselines`) introduced: batch-download, media-preview, streaming-playback specs; cleanup-helpers.ts; staging-journey-timing.json baselines; new fixture files (mp3, mp4, pdf); and removed the old load-test spec and playwright.load.config.ts.
There is a pending todo: debug BYO IPFS `register-cid` 400 errors on staging (`.planning/todos/pending/2026-03-29-debug-byo-ipfs-register-cid-400-errors-on-staging.md`).

code.finding: Added `COMMITTED_FIXTURES` guard to `createTestMediaFile`, `createTestImageFile`, `createTestTextFile`, and `createTestBinaryFile` to prevent cleanup from overwriting or deleting committed fixture files when the generated file name matches a source fixture name.
Missing `faro_enabled: true` metadata field — added by CodeRabbit fix in commit 9ca1fbb.
Teardown called `page.evaluate()` without first checking `page.isClosed()`, risking errors when the page was already closed. Fixed by adding a `page.isClosed()` guard.

Added `retrigger-release-gate` job that runs after E2E completes on main: finds any open release-please PR and re-runs its release gate workflow via `gh run rerun`, forcing re-evaluation of MAIN_SHA against latest main. Copilot flagged: (1) the `gh run rerun` command needs `--failed` or explicit run ID, and (2) the `runs-on` field for the retrigger job was missing.

workflow: When a CI check auto-passes for non-qualifying branches, it silently undermines branch protection — the check being 'required' is meaningless if it always passes green.
The correct fix for stale release gate checks is to retrigger the gate *after* E2E completes on main, not to run E2E inline on feature PRs.
Polling for review bot comments requires patience with rate-limited bots; background tasks with periodic checks work but create noise — ~20+ background polls were spawned in this session.
Resolving GitHub review threads requires both a REST reply (using `--field in_reply_to=INTEGER`) and a separate GraphQL `resolveReviewThread` mutation — they are independent operations.

friction: CodeRabbit was rate-limited for ~23 minutes after being re-requested, causing extensive polling loops with 20+ background tasks.
PR #393 was opened for the wrong problem (adding E2E to feature PRs) before understanding the actual issue was stale checks on the release-please PR — required closing and a new PR.
Finding the correct REST comment IDs to reply to review threads required multiple exploratory `gh api` calls because the GraphQL thread IDs differ from REST comment IDs.
Background polling created many completed task notifications that cluttered the conversation after the session ended.
open_items: PR #394 (retrigger-release-gate fix) still needs review and merge — Copilot flagged two issues in the new `retrigger-release-gate` job that were fixed but not yet verified in CI.
